name: Mariechen Danz, Friedrich Einhoff, Xie Lei: 'Carriers'
description: alexander levy opens 'Carriers,' a group show featuring Mariechen Danz, Friedrich Einhoff, and Xie Lei. The opening reception is Friday, February 27 from 6–9pm, with the exhibition running until April 11, 2026. The show explores the concept of transmission—what bodies, objects, and images carry, and how meaning is transferred across contexts and materials.
